name: com.handmesh.depthrefinement
description: Refines RGB Recon (MobRecon) 3D hand joints using AR Foundation device depth (iOS LiDAR sceneDepth / cross-platform environmentDepth). Joint-wise depth sampling, shift-only root-depth alignment, confidence fusion, bone-length constraint, and One-Euro temporal filtering. Mobile-optimized, 30 FPS target.

samples.description: Draws RGB vs refined joints and bones; colors joints by wasRefined.
